bodyText:
# Install Docker Engine

This guide explains how to install Docker Engine.

> **Note:** Docker Engine requires a 64-bit kernel.

## Prerequisites

Before installing, review the supported platforms.

| Platform | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Ubuntu | Yes |
| Debian | Yes |
| CentOS | No |

## Install using the convenience script

Run the following commands:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o get-docker.sh
sudo sh get-docker.sh
```

## Post-installation steps

Complete these steps after installing:

- Create the docker group
- Add your user to the group
- Log out and back in

## See also

See the release notes for details.
